about: Gate 219 (TC-R361..362), no browser: every case row in claude/stories/*.md that publishes 'N PASS / M FAIL lines naming <id> in <log>' (today the five TC-INV rows 02a, 02b, 02c, 02d and 03, citing 548b-all.log) is re-counted in its cited log by the cell's own rule, and N and M must match. This closes the 14 Nov checker's caveat on verify-log.sh --citations arm (2), which checks only that the id occurs. The one situation is the committed tree (the records have no geometry). NOT COVERED: rows that publish a result in any other form (arm (2) and the citations door hold those), TC-INV-01, which publishes no result.
